I just finished reading Andrew J Morgan’s excellent novel, VESSEL, and posting a review of it on Amazon.com.  Here it is:

REVIEW TITLE: A Better Extant Before Extant Came To Be

This is a very entertaining and enjoyable story that keeps dialing up the tension throughout. It is great fun to see an emerging indie author take advantage of the kindle self-publishing platform to get his work published where anyone can find it and Andrew Morgan has really shown off some good stuff in Vessel. If you like your sci-fi with a focus on realistic technology back-dropped by a looming alien threat and earthly conspiracies, you should like this one.
